text:
jordan: FYI Orpheus Bank wants a 10-day eval to swap out VendorX. Key asks: minimal code changes, identical JSON schema, and predictable billing. They want a staging smoke next Wed. Can we scope?

lea: Ill run the POC plan. Need: their current request/response schema, sample payloads (CSV and JSON), plus the security questionnaire. Also confirm whether they rely on streaming events vs token deltas.

mike: I can build a thin compatibility shim that rewrites headers and response fields. Estimate 48-72h to get a drop-in proxy with tests. Will need sample failures to mirror error semantics.

nisha: Security gating: BYOK requirement? audit log exports? They flagged GDPR data residency and a retention policy of 90 days with deletion hooks. If they insist on HSM keys we might need Dedicated or Private. Also SSO/SCIM is a must for their ops team.

jordan: They said BYOK preferred but will accept Dedicated with attestation for POC. Ask legal for a short attestation letter.

mike: Tokenization note: VendorX uses a different tokenizer which shifts token counts ~+8% on average. I'll include a token-normalizer layer and a per-request token-report so they can reconcile billing.

lea: Acceptance criteria suggestion:
- 20 representative requests pass parity checks (semantic similarity >=0.9)
- No schema diffs for downstream parsers in the 20 smoke cases
- p95 latency <500ms in their EU staging region
- Billing reconciliation report delivered with mapping doc
- Security questionnaire answered with no critical findings

jordan: For billing, propose free POC credits + a reconciliation CSV showing VendorX vs Redwood token counts and cost estimates. Does that work?

nisha: Agree. Also enable an option to redact request bodies in logs for PII tests. We can mask at ingress for selected routes.

mike: Example curl for shim: 
```
curl -X POST https://poc.orpheus-shim.redwood.ai/complete \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"<sample>","max_tokens":256}'
```
Return shape will mirror VendorX: {"id":...,"outputs":[{"text":...}],"meta":{}}

infra-bot: infra: reserved subnet orpheus-poc created in eu-west-1, egress IPs assigned 3.17.45.22, 3.17.45.23. Credentials sent via secure DM.

lea: We'll need a canary plan: route 5% of traffic through shim -> parity checks -> 100% if pass. Document rollback steps in runbook.

jordan: One potential blocker: Orpheus requires bilateral pen-test report and contract clause for incident notification <24h. Flagging for legal.

nisha: Also ask if they want deterministic seeds for generation to reduce output variance during evaluation. We can enable deterministic sampling on the POC model.

mike: I'll add a prompt-normalizer that strips vendor-specific macros and normalizes whitespace/quotes to reduce semantic drift. Will add unit tests.

lea: Ask Orpheus to provide ~200 anonymized production samples (scrubbed) and their parser test harness so we can run end-to-end.

jordan: Scheduling kickoff with Orpheus Mon 10am UTC. I'll attach their questionnaire and a sample CSV in the invite. Anything else?

nisha: Confirm support hours and escalation path for the POC. Also confirm whether they want logs exported to their SIEM (we can ship via syslog/HTTPS).

jordan: Noted. Thanks all, will post meeting notes and follow-ups here after the kickoff.
